_note: ER prototype objects. The ER profile in image-policy.json refuses people and body parts on these brands, so every ER photo is an object still life. Ground is a plain neutral grey for a clean cutout; the cutout gets composited onto the brand's own canvas. Aspect is stated in the text because the web chat takes no aspect parameter.

images.name: er-xray-forearm
images.prompt: Horizontal orientation. A single greyscale radiograph film of a forearm and wrist, the bones clearly visible, the film lying flat and squarely to camera on a plain seamless light grey surface, no clips, no markings, no lettering on the film

images.name: er-thermometer-water
images.prompt: Horizontal orientation. A still life of an unbranded white digital thermometer lying beside a plain clear glass of water on a plain seamless light grey surface, photographed from a low three-quarter angle, no labels and no lettering

images.name: er-head-ct
images.prompt: Horizontal orientation. A single greyscale CT scan film of a head in cross section, the film lying flat and squarely to camera on a plain seamless light grey surface, no clips, no markings, no lettering on the film

images.name: er-co-detector
images.prompt: Horizontal orientation. A plain round white unbranded carbon monoxide detector lying face up on a plain seamless light grey surface, photographed from a low three-quarter angle, no lettering and no logos on the device
